title: Retry Funnel Sampler + Payload Collation Canvas
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Prototype a compact, high-signal panel for the Console that helps SREs and engineers quickly understand retry funnels across models and routes, correlate retry buckets with representative payload samples, and surface likely root causes without leaving the ticket.

Background: Current error views are good at showing individual failed requests and traces, but teams often need to detect whether a spike is coming from many independent 1-off errors or a small set of repeatable payloads (e.g., malformed prompts, webhook timeouts, KV cache eviction pattern). The Retry Funnel Sampler should make it easy to: aggregate retries by reason, inspect canonical payloads for each bucket, and mark buckets for follow-up (snooze/assign/attach to incident).

User stories:
- As an SRE, I want to see an at-a-glance funnel for retries so I can prioritize high-volume buckets.
- As an engineer, I want to open a minimal payload sampler for a retry bucket to inspect the input, metadata, and first-failure and last-failure timestamps.
- As an incident lead, I want to mark a bucket as "ongoing" and attach it to a rollout or PR for follow-up.

Core components proposed:
1) Retry Funnel bar with top N buckets (by volume) and % of total retries. Clicking a bucket reveals a right-side "collation canvas".
2) Collation Canvas: three vertical panes (summary, sampler list, quick-actions). Summary shows bucket taxonomy (inferred cause tags: network, auth, model-oom, user-error), historical trend, and top routes/models. Sampler list shows 5 canonical payloads (representative examples chosen by dedup heuristics) with tokenized preview, frequency, and first/last seen. Quick-actions include: create incident, assign, mute, open full trace, export payload.
3) Lightweight dedup heuristics and privacy note: hashing + normalization for PII stripping; sample preview truncation with a link to full payload in secure view if allowed by org settings.

Acceptance criteria:
- Design comps for funnel + canvas in desktop and narrow-width layouts (no mobile required).
- Interaction spec for: bucket expansion, sampler pagination, quick-actions, and copy/export flow.
- Accessibility review: keyboard focus order for canvas, contrast checks for funnel bars, screen-reader labels for sample previews.
- Performance constraints: panel must render within 200ms on average for 90th percentile accounts; deferred loading for full payload details.

Out of scope: full incident timeline integration, deep replay of payloads inside the UI (this will be an ENG integration follow-up).

Notes on uniqueness: This artifact intentionally collates "bucket-first" analysis instead of single-request forensics used elsewhere; it emphasizes representative sampling and triage actions rather than replay-centric debugging.
